description: GPU EVENT_INFO version 2.0 (R620+). Bytes 4-7 of the 13-byte device-specific payload contain ModuleInstance, ChipletId, MigAttribution, and EventScope.

EventOriginator.description: Event originator names implemented by the current GPU driver: 0=Invalid, 2=PF GSP Firmware, 3=VF GSP Firmware, 4=PF Driver, and 5=VF Driver. Undefined values render as Unknown.

migAttribution.description: MIG attribution as 'GpuInstance:ComputeInstance' (high nibble : low nibble), or 'N/A' for the raw value 0xFF

eventScope.description: Scope / blast radius of the event (values TBD in spec)

Pdi.description: Globally unique 64-bit per-device identifier, MAC-style formatted
